subject: Minor room issue before deadline
text:
Dear Professor,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to report a small issue with the room booking for Thursday's graduate workshop. When I checked the calendar this morning, the seminar room still showed as unavailable, even though the department office confirmed that our reservation was approved. The event is unchanged, but the online listing suggests that another group may also have been given the key access.

This is likely only a system delay, but with the revised manuscript deadline falling on Friday, I do not want us to lose preparation time on Thursday. The tight schedule makes me reluctant to wait until the last possible moment. We had planned to use the projector and set out the printed cases before lunch. If the access is not corrected by tomorrow, we can use the second-floor study room, though it has fewer outlets and a smaller table.

If you would like, I can contact the scheduling office again and ask them to confirm the lock code by email. I will also check the door handle, in case the card reader is offline. Alternatively, I can bring my laptop and run the session from my office if the room situation remains unresolved. I can bring a backup cable as well. I have already prepared the handouts and asked two teaching assistants to arrive fifteen minutes early.

Thank you for your guidance on the most appropriate course of action. I will keep the update brief unless anything changes.

Best regards,
